lines.x: Leaving all this work to me? Hahahaha, I appreciate your trust.

It's Siracusan tradition to mask up and dress formally for a kill, but the people of Nuova Volsinii think such costuming means embracing a new life. But no matter the occasion, you must find the best tailor for the job, no? I certainly have.

Ah, what nice weather today—Siracusa's rainy season is over, and the Grey Hall old guy can no longer stay in their seats as all the hungry opportunists rush in. Hahahaha, could the Carnival have been such a roaring success without my help?

If the left sword drops first, we donate the wineries to the city. If the right sword falls first, then the wineries offer free admission to everyone at next year's Carnival. Hahahaha, even as that obsessive, controlling father of mine rots away in jail, the Siracusans will never forget him!

The families, the government, Signora Sicilia... every party has proved their own theories for their own gain. But how is a new city enough? What they want is a brand new country! And me? I want to see all their wishes come true, all of them!

Quiet. I won't have another 'wasteland', or 'civilization' enter my ears. Our new game is not so boring. You must learn quickly how the humans play… Oh. Hehehe, you overheard me, Doctor? Then how about you be my enemy? Come, stand against me.

Texas said I'd show up eventually? Aha! She knows me so well. Anyone would burn her prison to the ground, but how many dare to remain and see what's left in the ashes? Hehe, there is no shame in running away. But after that, you pray every day! Pray that the inferno won't haunt your nightmares!

Whiskey, on the rocks, with a mint garnish. Don't mind me, just knocking a few back while you carry on with your grand ambitions. But if I were you, I'd ease up on the goodness. Or the suffering will double when it all comes crashing down.

You care very much for Rhodes Island, much as Texas cares for her companions. Woo yeah... that serious look on your face! Very good! Why don't we make a wager, with this landship... You count me in as part of this place too? Hmmm... Very interesting, Doctor.
Oh, dear Doctor, what would you trade for the peaceful nights you once knew?
Long time no see. Oh no, did my weapon take your seat on the sofa...? A pity I was here first. What happened on the Carnival stage, you ask? Why so curious?
Bah. What a bore!
I refuse. I don't think Rhodes Island could throw a decent Carnival, even if we put a mask on each and every one of you.
Are you trying to placate me? Or do you think the game isn't fun enough...? I just can't see through you. No wonder I find your trust so entertaining!
Where stand the wilds? Where stand the cities?
A wolfpack I am.
Ah, the parade's here.
The mad lead the blind! Hahahaha! 'Tis no wonder they never tire!
The show hasn't started, and this place is already such a riot!
Look, Zaaro! See the game we humans are born playing—
Your weapons are right at your fingertips, why wait?
No need to cover up! If secrets go public, then everybody is in the game!
What should I do? I knew who you were right away.
What are you waiting for? The curtains are about to fall!
The spotlight shines on us. Hahahaha!
Do not disappoint tonight, my friends.
A grand spectacle, a perfect show, a dignified exit. Bravo, Bravo… But I won't applaud, not without an accident befalling the act, haha.
Work's over, time for a drink. Where is Texas?
Come gawp at those whose masks have fallen. Some carefree, struck with panic. Some let loose, so free and manic! Oh, what fun to prowl this ball!
Defeat? Hahahaha. That's just the end of Act One.
It's quiet in here—not afraid to miss the excitement outside?
Haha... is this how you greet Texas too?
Come here! Dance with the wolves.
Arknights.

Happy New Year! You're inviting me in? How will you introduce me? Texas's archenemy, the Saluzzo traitor, or the white wolf who would conquer all? Hahahaha... Enjoy the evening, Doctor. For tomorrow, the twin moons shall rise for the hunt... like always.
Here's a Carnival costume. Put it on.

One birthday, my father brought me to tour a vineyard in bloom. I wondered why there was no monstrous vehicle to run it down to ruin, along with the whole of Siracu— What? No, I bought this bottle of wine off some random shelf. That manor became a trash heap long ago.

Hah, the things you and the Rhodes Islanders do are quite interesting indeed. Siracusa, no, everywhere of this land is a filthy swamp, yet Rhodes Island manages to hold on still. Is it because you're so adaptable, or... did you have a hand in writing the rules of the game?
Ohi, Zaaro, still not done washing those glasses? Enough cracking the ice cubes, Caesar… Keep your hats on tight and ears perked up—we have to hear the new Boss's stirring speech before we open.
An unlicensed bar, an omnipotent bartender, and one simple rule: You're the Boss today, free to dominate all that you see. Haha, put all your embarrassing desires onto the wine list.

Try it. It's a 'Demon Sunrise', brought here by your predecessor, a refugee Snowpriest from Sami. Good stuff, no? I know you won't disappoint us—even if the wolves tear you to shreds, your legacy will only grow.

Done for the day! The place is yours now, I trust you have the time and space to tinker with your 'secrets'. Call it the Boss's privilege. Zaaro, is the car still not ready? Ssh—a word of advice: Don't ask where your employees go after work.

Of course I like the bar. Without it, where would I find the inspiration for new games to play? It's lawless? Hmph, Agnese, why don't you tell our good Boss, how we've been waiting every day for the police to knock on our door with an arrest warrant? It can't be helped, we get either baddies, or poor things like you.

I said before I want you to be my enemy, but this doesn't stop me from realizing your wishes. Texas is no stranger to this either. This bar will be a valve for the swamp. You can decide to turn it off, or let the mud flow. Isn't this much more interesting than being boring old enemies?

Done thinking, O savior of ours? Will you share a bottle with the Church of the Deep and the Yurodstvo, or perhaps consult the revenants on how to make Rhodes Island soar past the starpod? Haha, feel free to go wild—give yourself, and your employees, a challenge!

Yes, the Cyclops in the recording was a Boss once. He tried using the 'tragic future' glimpsed through his foresight to change my rules, but what a pity—just five minutes before his shift ended, he threw up blood and died… Oh, you're an expert in this field too, no?

An ice cube? Open your eyes, Boss. That's a roccia in your glass. Do you want to see its creator, your old friend? In this bar, you can do it all. Of course I know the thing, and of course I can do it. For the low price of… suffering? Haha, I'd be glad to oblige!
Still undecided? Haha, just a friendly reminder: The ice's melted—it's rude to keep a bartender and her drinks waiting.
Haha, keep your hood on. You're the Boss of this bar now. Lappland and her merry pack of wolves, at your service.
There is nothing new under the twin moons.
Congratulations! The wolfpack and I have not lost patience with you, for now.
My gratitude, Boss. You've instilled a passion in us for our work—for now, at least.
Ohi, Vargo. Get our thirsty Boss and me a couple shots of whiskey to wet our whistles.
I'm still waiting for you to tell me what 'order' means.
Earlier opening hours? You're the Boss.
You want some ice to chew on? Keeps the pain away, and keeps you awake.
Ohi, Zaaro! Patience!
Haha, was that a yawn from me?
Interesting! Agnese, Vargo. Don't get in my way.
What a bore… Zaaro, Caesar. Sweep the place, quickly.
Here you go—a 'Civilizzato Classico'.
Enjoy—'Barrenlands' Special Brew'.
Bartender's Choice—'Custom-made Quagmire'.
It's happy hour!
All drinks on the house.
Not bad. I haven't seen the wolfpack so enthusiastic in a long while.
Is this what you wanted? You know the price of boring me, don't you, Boss?
When will a new Boss come…? Zaaro, why isn't this one gone yet?
So this is the decor you're planning to draw crowds with?
Olives for you? Yes, I've changed the specials again.
Zaaro, bite down on the Boss's head. I want to see what's inside.
Arknights.

Here, a vodka martini with five olives. Don't worry, just sample your employee's craft. Bravo. One more shot, and tell me all about your grand master plan to save or destroy Terra—this will be my New Year's gift to you.
Friendly reminder—you're running out of time to boss me around.

I get it, a wish you've pondered a thousand times, when spoken aloud on your birthday, will double the chances of coming true—ohi, my wolves and I are right before you, so why are you still making your wish with your eyes closed?

A single ark, along with the fate of millions, haha. Same little ambition as always. Though, I truly can't imagine what exactly you'll destroy and leave behind… I expect you to reward me with that pleasant surprise, Boss.
